_about: Gilbert Murray (1866-1957), Regius Professor of Greek at Oxford. His verse translations of the Greek plays are on the euripides, aeschylus and sophocles shelves and his Poetics on aristotle; this shelf holds his own scholarship. He died in 1957, but every book here was published before 1930. Project Gutenberg: Five Stages of Greek Religion; Euripides and His Age. Raw IA OCR: A History of Ancient Greek Literature (Heinemann; first impression 1897, this the impression of 1911); The Rise of the Greek Epic (Oxford, 1907); The Interpretation of Ancient Greek Literature, inaugural lecture (Oxford, 1909); Tradition and Progress (Houghton Mifflin, 1922). Held: The Classical Tradition in Poetry (1927); one scan is a 1957 Vintage reprint and the other's imprint year is cut off after 'MCMXXX'. His surname is common, so only the full name is used. US public domain. No uids minted.
